title: _registerOnV2 decodes V1 stablecoinConfigs as a 7-field struct but the deployed PhusdStableMinter V1 returns 4 fields — ABI buffer-overrun revert bricks config replication (deployed-ABI drift)
description: The script's inline IMinterV1 interface declares stablecoinConfigs as returning a 7-field struct, but the deployed PhusdStableMinter V1 returns only 4 fields. When _registerOnV2 calls stablecoinConfigs on the deployed V1 minter, the 7-field decode overruns the return buffer and reverts. This is a second, independent fatal blocker: even if M-01 (DEDUP-001) were fixed, this separately bricks the migration. The underlying V1 data (rate=1e18, dec=18) IS readable via the correct 4-tuple ABI, so the defect is purely an interface-shape drift in the script, not missing on-chain data.
impact: Protocol function/availability: config replication (the script's stated purpose) cannot execute; the migration aborts. No funds at direct risk — the V1 minter retains authority and the revert is atomic/fail-loud (simulate-then-broadcast dispatches nothing). Independent of M-01.
attackPath: Owner runs migrate:saga2.1-deploy against live mainnet (assume M-01 hypothetically resolved or reached independently).
_registerOnV2 calls stablecoinConfigs on the deployed V1 minter via the script's 7-field IMinterV1 declaration.
Deployed V1 returns a 4-field struct; the 7-field decode overruns the return buffer.
The call reverts atomically during simulation; config replication cannot proceed; migration aborts.
recommendation: Correct the inline IMinterV1.stablecoinConfigs return type to match the deployed V1 minter's actual 4-field tuple (verified against on-chain ABI/bytecode), then map those fields onto the V2 registration. Add a pre-flight ABI-shape probe that fails with a clear diagnostic before the broadcast block.

evidence.observed: Fork preview reproduces the buffer-overrun revert independently of M-01 (via diagnostic bypass of the _carryBuffer revert).
evidence.atomicity: Revert at line ~148 (call site) is before the authority swaps; nothing broadcast.

downgradeReason: Same as M-01: guaranteed fail-loud atomic revert, availability blocker, no asset risk. Kept SEPARATE from M-01 per Law 1 (distinct independently-fatal blocker; merging would hide that fixing M-01 alone does not unbrick the migration). Severity-auditor CONFIRM (high confidence).
faithfulnessNote: Script cannot replicate V1 config as intended; routed to F-XX spec-conformance while retaining honest Medium per Law 1.
